text.zh-CN: 原报告补液和胰岛素治疗后酮体转阴，第9天患者因工作要求出院，初诊为类固醇糖尿病伴酮症酸中毒。 原表1：第3天空腹12.9、午餐后23.8 mmol/L；第9天空腹9.8、晚餐后10.2 mmol/L。仅作历史测量，不转写剂量。
text.en: Fluids and insulin were followed by negative ketones; the patient requested discharge for work on day9, initially labelled steroid diabetes with ketoacidosis. SourceTable1 records day3 fasting12.9 and post-lunch23.8 mmol/L, and day9 fasting9.8 and post-dinner10.2 mmol/L. These are historical measurements, not dose instructions.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 一年余后中断胰岛素再发DKA，IAA和ICA阳性、GAD65阴性。表2第一次检查0/120 min C肽0.3/0.5 nmol/L，血糖5.5/23.8 mmol/L；第二次0/120 min C肽0.1/0.2 nmol/L，血糖7.5/20.2 mmol/L。两表为后续检查，不能替代初发时值。之后持续胰岛素依赖、体重下降20 kg、血糖波动，作者修正为暴发1型糖尿病；当前仅可保留这一原诊断并标明标准无法完全复现。
text.en: Over a year later, interruption of insulin preceded recurrentDKA; IAA/ICA were positive andGAD65 negative. Table2 gives first-test fasting/120-minute C-peptide0.3/0.5 nmol/L with glucose5.5/23.8 mmol/L, and second-test C-peptide0.1/0.2 nmol/L with glucose7.5/20.2 mmol/L. These later measurements cannot substitute for onset values. Persistent insulin dependence,20 kg weight loss and variable glucose led the authors to label fulminant type1 diabetes, but its complete criteria cannot be reproduced from the available onset evidence.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒，需要先处理代谢急症再判断分型
text.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis, requiring acute treatment before final classification

feedback.zh-CN: 高血糖、酮体和酸血症三者同时存在。
feedback.en: Hyperglycaemia, ketosis and acidaemia are all present.

text.zh-CN: 仅是无危险的激素后餐后血糖偏高
text.en: Only harmless steroid-related postprandial hyperglycaemia

feedback.en: This does not explain pH7.25 and marked ketosis.

text.zh-CN: HbA1c不足9%可排除糖尿病急症
text.en: HbA1c below9% excludes a diabetic emergency

feedback.en: HbA1c does not negate current DKA evidence.

prompt.zh-CN: 初次稳定后，什么计划更安全？
prompt.en: Which plan is safer after initial stabilisation?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 核对胰岛功能与糖尿病分型，落实胰岛素、血糖/酮体监测和病日教育
text.en: Assess beta-cell function and classification, with insulin, glucose/ketone monitoring and sick-day education

feedback.zh-CN: 不能先假定激素停用后一定不需要胰岛素。
feedback.en: Steroid withdrawal must not be assumed to eliminate insulin need.

text.zh-CN: 因为曾用激素，出院后自行停胰岛素
text.en: Stop insulin after discharge because steroids were used

feedback.zh-CN: 病因未定而停药可导致再发酮症。
feedback.en: Stopping treatment with uncertain insulin dependence risks recurrence.

text.zh-CN: 不监测血糖，只在口渴时补一次胰岛素
text.en: Avoid monitoring and use insulin only when thirsty

feedback.zh-CN: 这样无法安全管理血糖或预防酮症。
feedback.en: This cannot safely manage glycaemia or prevent ketosis.

prompt.zh-CN: 复盘后续资料，怎样表述原“暴发1型”诊断？
prompt.en: How should the reported fulminant-type1 label be expressed after follow-up?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 表2支持后续胰岛分泌下降，不能替代初发标准；IAA在用胰岛素后测得，分型需专科复核
text.en: Table2 supports declining later insulin secretion but cannot replace onset criteria; post-insulin IAA and classification require specialist review

feedback.zh-CN: 2012JDS标准要求初发时极低C肽。现有后续数值不重现该条件，仍不能证明药物因果。
feedback.en: The2012JDS criteria require very low C-peptide at onset. Later values do not reproduce that condition and cannot establish drug causality.

text.zh-CN: IAA阳性证明药物直接破坏胰岛
text.en: Positive IAA proves the drug directly destroyed beta cells

feedback.zh-CN: 外源胰岛素暴露与缺乏机制检测限制解释。
feedback.en: Exogenous insulin exposure and absent mechanistic tests limit interpretation.

text.zh-CN: 再次DKA证明所有激素相关糖尿病都不可逆
text.en: Recurrent DKA proves all steroid-associated diabetes is irreversible

feedback.zh-CN: 单个病例不能推出所有患者的结局。
feedback.en: One case cannot establish outcomes for every patient.

knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 皮疹与激素治疗后发生DKA，长期胰岛素依赖促使原作者改称暴发1型。已核对表2，但后续C肽不能代替初发分型标准；药物致病机制未证实。
conclusion.en: DKA after a skin eruption and steroid exposure led to persistent insulin dependence and the source label of fulminant type1 diabetes. Table2 has been checked, but later C-peptide values cannot replace onset classification criteria; drug causality remains unproven.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先识别DKA，不因激素暴露忽略酸中毒。
出院教育必须覆盖监测及避免自行中断必要胰岛素。
keyReasoning.en: Discharge education covers monitoring and avoiding interruption of essential insulin.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 时间关联不等于药物免疫致病证据。
keyReasoning.en: Temporal association does not establish drug-mediated immune causality.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
